scenarios.title: The cost is proportionate

linkedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG017-06 cost ratio evaluator rejects a known over-bound comparison
Regression: SCN-022-015 a pack year mismatch refuses and shows no combined figure
Regression: SCN-021-02 a declared pack delayed below the bound settles with every figure identical to the undelayed settlement

scenarios.mappingNote: The committed scripts/validate-playwright-cost-ratio.mjs helper owns the shared FR-017-004 predicate for live and deterministic inputs. The exact authored focused regression proves 3.000 is accepted and 3.001 is refused without owned temporary residue. The identical 22-file workload runs under system-chrome and bundled chromium at the configured one-worker default; both live legs exit zero and the measured ratio is no more than 3.0. The deterministic control complements rather than replaces the live pair. Historical two-worker timing supports threshold selection but is not a human-observed acceptance result for the selected one-worker fallback.

obligations.requiredProof: The committed ratio evaluator rejects a deterministic over-bound comparison through the same predicate used by live mode, and the identical workload runs under system-chrome and bundled chromium at the selected worker count with a recorded ratio that meets FR-017-004.
satisfiedBy: tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs#Regression: SCN-BUG017-06 cost ratio evaluator rejects a known over-bound comparison

testMechanism.negativeControl: The ratio CLI creates and removes an isolated temporary comparison record. Its at-bound control evaluates 3000/1000 as 3.000 and exits zero; its over-bound control changes only systemChromeWallMs to 3001, keeps bundledChromiumWallMs at 1000 and FR-017-004 at 3.000, routes both controls through the same predicate used by live mode, and exits 1 with SCN-BUG017-06: wall-time ratio 3.001 exceeds FR-017-004 maximum 3.000.
